name: SIP Calculator
description: Estimate the future value of your monthly SIP contributions based on investment amount, expected return, and duration.

name: Lumpsum Calculator
description: Calculate the future value of a single lumpsum investment compounded annually over your chosen tenure and rate of return.

name: Goal Planning Calculator
description: Work backward from a targeted wealth goal to find out how much you need to invest today, with optional inflation adjustment.

name: CAGR Calculator
description: Find the compound annual growth rate between a starting and ending value — plus 13 more growth tools covering future value, present value, duration, inflation-adjusted returns, stock and fund CAGR, and side-by-side comparisons.

name: Retirement Planning Calculator
tagline: Build the corpus for a happy retirement
description: Work out the retirement corpus you will need based on your current age, retirement age, life expectancy, expected returns, and inflation — plus the monthly SIP required to get there.

name: FD vs Market Calculator
tagline: Safety versus growth, side by side
description: Compare what your money would grow to in a Fixed Deposit versus the market, for either a monthly investment or a one-time lumpsum, over your chosen tenure.

name: DCF Calculator
tagline: Find a stock's true intrinsic value
description: Estimate a company's intrinsic value per share by discounting projected free cash flows and terminal value back to today, then compare it against the current market price with a margin of safety.
